info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Details API
info.description: The Customer Account Details API provides access to detailed information about a specific customer account. By querying the endpoint with the unique identifiers of a customer and their account, clients can retrieve essential account data, such as transaction history and current balances. This API is particularly useful for customer service representatives and financial analysts who need to review account specifics for inquiries or reporting tasks. Seamlessly integrating this API into applications aids businesses in enhancing their customer support and financial management capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve account details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific account belonging to a customer. You can retrieve attributes such as account status, balance, and transaction history.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the details of a specific account associated with a customer. This request will return detailed information related to the account specified by the account ID.

GetCustomerAccountDetailsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving account details for a specific customer and account.

routingNumber.description: The routing number associated with the account.

realAccountNumber.description: The real account number for the customer.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the account response.

GetCustomerAccountDetailsResponse_200.description: Represents the details of a specific account response for a given customer.

correlationId.description: ID used to correlate this request with other requests.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

AccountMetadata.description: Contains metadata information regarding the account response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Unique identifier for the API endpoint that has been called, which helps in tracing the request for support or analysis.

X-Runtime-App.description: Name of the application where the request is processed, useful for identifying the source application during request handling.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Token for authentication, utilizing JSON Web Tokens (JWT) as the format for the token. It allows the API to authenticate requests made by clients by verifying the provided token.
